qa_pairs.question: What kind of information is presented in the scheduler section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The scheduler section of the Metrix portal shows information on the scheduler and allows users to access details about their CPU accounts.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user display specific information for their CPU account within the scheduler section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: To display information on your CPU account within the scheduler section of the Metrix portal, you need to click on your account number.
